name: Auto Flow Calibration
author: Decent
description: Helps the machine’s flow estimate match your scale, with automatic calibration or a manual value for each profile. Supervise calibration changes.

Enabled.label: Enable calibration changes
Enabled.description: Allow automatic and manual changes on the selected DE1. Wait for each update before starting another shot. Do not run the temporary updater plugin alongside this plugin.

ExpectedSerial.label: DE1 serial number
ExpectedSerial.description: Only this machine can be calibrated. Leave blank to prevent changes.
